title: Urban pollination networks with stochastic block models
text:
Material of my 3-hour course at the school Biodiversité urbaine : enjeux et modélisation (Institut Henri Poincaré, Paris, 25–27 November 2026): analysis of urban pollination networks with stochastic block models (SBM, colSBM) and network comparison.
Running example: Baldock et al. (2019), Nature Ecology & Evolution 3: 363–373. Plant–pollinator networks in 4 UK cities × 9 land uses.

title: Urban pollination networks with stochastic block models
text:
R companion

 R companion of the slides: the R code that produces the analyses of the slides, step by step, with its results.
 Code and data (zip): the Quarto source of the companion (companion_slides_UK.qmd), the data of Baldock et al. (2019) with the script that builds the networks from them, and the estimation scripts (scripts/).
 Estimation results (zip): the fitted models (.rds). Unzip it inside the code folder, so that the files are in results_analysis/: the companion then reads the fits instead of re-estimating them (some colSBM fits take about 30 min each).

Render the companion from the code folder with quarto render companion_slides_UK.qmd.
R packages: dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, patchwork, sbm, colSBM (≥ 0.4.11, GitHub GrossSBM/colSBM), bipartite, vegan.

title: Research interests
text:
I am specialized in the development of statistical learning methods for ecology and life sciences in general. More details here. I work with people from different backgrounds: statisticians, ecologists…

Development of probabilistic models and statistical learning methods for ecology and life sciences.

 


Models for complex interaction network data: multi-level, multiplex, multipartite …
Models defined by ordinary and stochastic differential equations.
Bayesian statistics: elicitation of a priori distribution and combination of expert
Bayesian parametric and nonparametric statistics for counting processes. Statistical Inference for Gaussian Graphical Models
Stochastic algorithms: MCMC, EM and stochastic versions, particule filters …
Applications in ecology: interaction networks pollinating plants, insects,

 


Other Application fields : neuroscience, pharmacokinetics, food risk, EDF reliability, social networks
